reason: Conversation 2 immediately and correctly identifies 22E as the fridge fan error, explains the likely ice build-up cause, gives the exact sensible first step (24-48h unplugged manual defrost with food in a cool box), sets the right safety boundary (no panel removal, engineer for defrost heater/sensor/fan), flags warranty, and honestly warns that recurrence means engineer attention. Conversation 1 never explains what 22E means despite being asked directly, grinds through generic recovery-time/settings/vent/seal checks with repeated verbatim re-asks when the customer had already answered, misreads '9C' as a code, and after nine turns has only just reached listening for the fan — no defrost suggestion, no escalation, no warranty advice. Conversation 2's only weakness is lack of interactivity and a slightly vague warranty note, which is minor by comparison.
